translations.web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
translations.bsb: I am just like you before God; I was also formed from clay.
translations.kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
translations.asv: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.
